verdicts.reason: A keeps a clean left text column with the right reading order, but the 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow is indented about 17px past the left edge of the headline, body and CTA. The middle third is dead space between the text and the can, and the CTA sits tight under the body copy. B breaks the design into scattered pieces: the headline drops below and left of its own body copy, the body copy and CTA float in the centre on a separate axis, and the legal line is shrunk to illegible micro-text under the circle, so the reading order and grouping fall apart.
